Container.Name: vacuula
Container.Overview: BETA CHANNEL: This template tracks the upstream :beta image. Vacuula is under active development; updates may introduce bugs or breaking changes. Back up /server/data before updating. The beta tag follows new builds when you update the container; it does not enable unattended updates by itself. Self-hosted Vacuula backend for Neato Botvac D3, D4, D5, D6 and D7, with a web app, maps and schedules. Gen4 is disabled in this template. Enroll the robot using the separate Vacuula Installer on a USB-connected computer. The installer modifies robot firmware. Home Assistant is not required.
Container.Description: BETA CHANNEL: Updates may introduce bugs, breaking changes or database migrations. Back up the complete appdata folder before updating. An older image may require its matching pre-update data backup if the database format has changed. Bridge networking with two TCP ports: 8088 for the web app and installer, and 335 for Gen3 robot traffic. A custom Docker bridge network may be selected. mDNS is disabled: enter the Unraid LAN IP and published web port as an HTTP URL in the installer. Keep the robot port at 335 on both sides of the mapping. Keep /server/data persistent: it contains the database, maps and the certificate/private key used by your enrolled robot. This is an independently maintained Unraid template for the upstream Vacuula image.

Config.Name: Web UI / installer port
Config.Description: Host port for the web app and installer. Change the host port here if 8088 is occupied; keep the internal VACUULA_PORT at 8088.

Config.Name: Neato D3-D7 port
Config.Description: Direct Gen3 robot connection. Keep host and container ports at 335. Do not route this port through an HTTP reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, maps, robot certificate and private key. Preserve and back up this folder when recreating the container.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used for cleaning schedules. Change for your location, e.g. Europe/London.

Config.Name: Internal web port
Config.Description: Internal listener. Keep at 8088 to match the Web UI port mapping target.

Config.Name: Internal Gen3 port
Config.Description: Internal robot listener and port reported to the installer. Must match the direct host port 335.

Config.Name: Enable Gen4
Config.Description: Disabled. This template does not publish the Gen4 port and is intended for D3-D7.

Config.Name: mDNS discovery
Config.Description: Disabled for bridge networking. Enter the Unraid LAN URL manually in the installer.

Config.Name: Container bind address
Config.Description: Listen on interfaces inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0 with bridge networking; do not enter the Unraid LAN IP here.
